versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "九三学社社情民意信息写作" skill.
- Provides step-by-step workflow and standard format requirements for writing official policy reflection documents for Jiusan Society.
- Includes detailed guidelines for titles, authorship, abstracts, content structure, citations, and formatting.
- Emphasizes the necessity of factual data with traceable sources, and cautions against using unverified AI-generated information.
- Offers quality checklist and sample references to ensure outputs meet official standards.
